title: Pure B.E.S.
summary: B.E.S. monsters and their Spells, with generic staples; the page's Rank 10 Train package is left out. The 2026 cards lead. Boss on Parade searches B.E.S. Derringer Core, which summons itself by revealing another B.E.S. and spends its counters to search B.E.F. Zelos or Boss Rush, or to revive a B.E.S. from the GY. Super B.E.S. Metal Slave sends up to five differently named B.E.S. from the Deck to summon itself with that many counters, then, on either turn, removes a counter to destroy one of their face-up cards together with one of your own B.E.S., which Boss Rush replaces. The list runs one copy each of the old ships to give it names to send. Zelos protects the fleet from targeting and destruction, and Boss Rush replaces each ship that falls. Boss Rush stops your Normal Summon, which matters little because nearly every ship summons itself.
